english.title: Trader engage in unfair commercial practice - Unfair Trading Regulations 2008
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a trader engaged in a commercial practice, namely **(..SPECIFY THE UNFAIR PRACTICE - SEE SCHEDULE 1..), which was unfair

english.notes:
(i) The Consumer Protection from Unfair Trading Regulations 2008 were repealed by the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 as of 6th April 2025. For offences committed on or after that date see H101737.
(ii) This offence only applies in relation to commercial practices set out in paragraphs 1 to 10, 12 to 27 and 29 to 31 of Schedule 1.
(iii) Unlike other offences under these Regulations, there is no need to consider the likely effect on consumers. However, a breach of regulation 12 may also breach the other provisions.

other.penalty:
Summary: fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex see regulation 14 of the Consumer Protection from Unfair Trading Regulations 2008 For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.
